Remote-First als gelebtes Modell
Wir arbeiten seit Jahren konsequent remote. Du entscheidest, von wo du am produktivsten bist - Homeoffice, Shared Office oder eine Mischung aus beidem.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Eigenverantwortung
Du kannst dir deine Arbeit im Rahmen der Projekte zeitlich flexibel über die Woche einteilen. Uns sind Verlässlichkeit im Team und transparente Kommunikation wichtiger als Präsenz am Schreibtisch.
Spannende Projekte statt Routine-Tickets
Gemeinsam finden wir Projekte, die zu deinem Profil und deiner Entwicklung passen - z. B. Plattformaufbau, Cloud-Migration, Automatisierung, Operations oder technische Schulungen bei Kund:innen.

title: Ohio Remote Clinical Therapist
description:
About WellQor :

WellQor is a patient centered, full-service psychological practice accessible online. We're a new model in care that marries the best of traditional and innovative approaches.
Unlike other online providers, our clinical therapists are one member of a team, collaborating with peers and a Clinical Director who is responsible for ensuring each patient is achieving the best possible outcomes. We're not a directory service, we're a full service psychology practice. Our clinicians enjoy the full support of a treatment team, and our patients benefit from the full attention of a robust clinical organization.
The WellQor organization was founded to serve the needs of specialized populations. WellQor serves the needs of mature adults, and Wellfam serves the needs of teens and adolescents. Our providers understand the unique situational issues and clinical mental health challenges of each population.
Our practice is growing rapidly, and we owe our success to a family-oriented culture that puts people first. As a new provider, expect to feel loved, appreciated, and supported in a way that’s truly unique to WellQor .

Your Role as a Remote Clinical Therapist:
At WellQor , you’ll help your clients overcome anxiety, deal with grief, forge better relationships with their families, and be the best versions of themselves. You’ll make a real, tangible difference in the lives of others, and feel good about the way you bring joy to the lives of others.
And you won’t have to do it alone. We follow a care-team treatment model, which means clinicians are assigned to teams which they can connect with and consult for advice, institutional knowledge, and continued feedback. Clinicians collaborate with our Clinical Directors to develop treatment plans and obtain valuable feedback to ensure the best possible patient outcomes.

You will define your own availability, make your own schedules, and work according to your lifestyle. Some WellQor therapists work part time, and others carry full caseloads. Whatever your lifestyle demands, we’re here to meet you where you’re at.
Why WellQor ?

• You’ll develop long-term relationships with patients via teletherapy.

• Have access to the full support and camaraderie of a clinical team.

• Select how much and when you work.

• Connect with therapists across the country using our Clinician Connect platform.

• Receive credentialing, billing, and administrative services so you can do what you do best, therapy!

Join the WellQor Family and let us build a caseload for you that fits your lifestyle.

Title: WellQor Telehealth Clinical Therapist

Reports to: Clinical Director / Lead Psychologist

Requirements:

• LPCC, LMFT, LMHC, LCSW, LICSW, PsyD or equivalent licensed to practice independently.

• Empanelment / Participation with commercial insurance plans helpful but not required

• Strong computer skills and comfort using mobile devices and electronic medical records systems for patient charting and communication

Responsibilities:

• Conduct regular teletherapy sessions with clients

• Typical issues that your patients may face include:

• Adjustment issues, anxiety, depression, personality disorders, grief, behavioral issues PTSD, substance abuse

• Enter and maintain appropriate documentation in WellQor 's, easy to use web based EHR system according to company guidelines.

• Utilize our unique WellQor Clinician Connect™ platform to share ideas with and obtain support from other WellQor clinicians and leadership nationwide.

Compensation:

WellQor Telehealth Therapists are paid by the billable hour and have the flexibility to take on the caseload that they're interested in carrying at any given time.

SpryPoint is modernizing how utilities serve their communities. As a high-growth software company, we're shaking up the status quo in the utility industry with the first and only truly cloud-native customer service and operations platform purpose-built for modern utilities.
Founded by industry veterans in 2011, we've grown from a profitable startup to a rapidly scaling company of 300+ employees serving 100+ utility clients across North America and the Caribbean. Our mission is simple: utility leaders should expect more from their technology providers.
Utilities face urgent demand to replace inefficient legacy systems while managing increasing operational complexity, and evolving customer expectations. With more than a decade of experience, and a track record of successful implementations spanning water, electric, and gas utilities, SpryPoint has built a reputation as a trusted and mission-critical partner to utilities across North America.
We deliver comprehensive solutions including SpryCIS, SpryEngage, SpryMobile, and SpryWallet that modernize the entire meter-to-cash process. What sets us apart? Our "updates, not upgrades" approach, user-centric design, and unwavering focus on customer success.
Backed by strategic investment from Norwest Venture Partners since 2023, and an exciting new investment partnership from Insight Partners announced in 2026, we're accelerating our growth while staying true to our core values: lead with kindness, vision with impact, radical honesty, bold disruption, keep it simple, and execute with excellence.
Join our award-winning team in transforming an essential industry that powers communities across the Americas.
We are standing up a dedicated QA automation function, and we're looking for a QA Engineering Manager to build and lead it from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to shape a quality practice from scratch: you'll choose the tooling, set the standards, hire the team, and define how AI fits into how we test.
This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading the team and doing the work yourself: setting direction, hiring, and coaching on one side, and writing automated tests, building framework components, and reviewing code on the other. You'll lead by example and stay close enough to the code to make sound calls and earn the trust of the engineers you lead.
In your first 90 days, you'll start with discovery: partnering with our Principal AI Engineer and AI team to understand existing AI tools and practices, and working with engineering teams to understand current QA practices and define how QA and engineering will collaborate going forward. In parallel, you'll confirm prerequisites (environments, CI/CD, critical user journeys), select your tooling and framework, and stand up a proof-of-concept suite on the highest-risk flows. By the end of year one, you'll have delivered a working, trusted automation suite on critical flows, a small high-performing team, a quality metrics dashboard in active use, and a clear plan for AI adoption.
What You Will Do

• Define and own the quality engineering strategy and roadmap across our products.

• Stay hands-on: personally write automated tests, build framework components, and review code alongside the team (roughly half your time).

• Select the test automation tooling and framework, and set the standards squads build on.

• Integrate automated testing into our CI/CD pipelines and partner with DevOps on stable, repeatable deployments.

• Define quality gates: what blocks a merge and what blocks a release, aligned with engineering leadership and risk.

• Drive a risk-based approach to testing so effort goes where it protects clients most.

• Push tests down the stack (API before UI), drive down the flaky-test rate, and enable squads so the practice doesn't depend on any one person.

• Hire, coach, and grow

title: Sr. Manager, Channel Partnerships
description:
About Betterment

Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.  We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).

About the role

The Senior Manager, Channel Partnerships role will be vital in executing our partnerships go-to-market motion focused on co-selling and referral partners for our Betterment at Work business line. This role will own a partnership’s channel and be responsible for acquisition, contracting, onboarding, and enablement. The role will collaborate deeply with sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, legal and finance.

This role is based in NYC. Below, we've reflected the base salary range we would offer for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to experience and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees.

• New York City: $135,000 - $160,000

This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of commission and an incentive bonus. 

A day in the life

• Source, negotiate, and sign new channel partners in priority verticals for Betterment at Work.

• Build joint go-to-market plans with each partner, team mapping, referral paths, rep incentives, and success metrics.

• Lead partner activation after signature by coordinating onboarding, training, launch materials, and internal handoffs.

• Work directly with partner leaders and frontline reps to drive introductions, co-selling activity, and qualified pipeline.

• Manage partner pipeline, forecasts, and activity in Salesforce, and report progress, risks, and results to leadership.

• Support strategic deals by aligning pricing, approvals, and cross-functional execution with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Legal, Finance, Product, and Compliance.

• Identify what is and is not working across the channel, and adjust messaging, enablement, and partner focus accordingly.

• Bring voice-of-partner and market feedback into the business to inform roadmap, positioning, and channel strategy.

What we’re looking for

• 3-7+ years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, business development, or strategic alliances, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, retirement, payroll/HCM, benefits, or adjacent financial services.

• Proven success building referral and co-selling partnerships that generate qualified pipeline and closed revenue.

• Strong commercial operator who can own the partnership lifecycle end to end, from prospecting and contracting through onboarding, enablement, and growth.

• Confident relationship builder with executive presence and the ability to work effectively across partner organizations and internal cross-functional teams.

• Data-driven and organized, with strong judgment, prioritization skills, and fluency in pipeline management, forecasting, and Salesforce discipline.

Join a team built on these core values

We change lives

Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease .

title: Manager Operations Escrow - Market Street Settlement Group LLC- Remote Northeast
description:
The Regional Operations Support Manager is a strategic partner dedicated to optimizing and supporting operational processes for escrow teams across multiple brands and states within assigned region. This role focuses on driving operational excellence, process standardization, and technology integration, while providing expert guidance and support to branch and regional escrow teams. This role collaborates closely with senior leadership, the National Operations Center, and cross-functional partners to ensure every operational touchpoint reflects the company’s values, vision, and commitment to service excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Operational Support & Process Optimization

• Analyze, refine, and standardize operational processes to increase efficiency and productivity for escrow assistants and closers in customer-facing roles.

• Collaborate with the National Operations Center (NOC) to develop and integrate standardized workflows between NOC and branches.

• Monitor and analyze operational KPIs to identify trends, drive performance, and implement improvements.

• Provide guidance, training, and support to regional escrow support departments, ensuring high team performance and job satisfaction.

Claims Management & Risk Mitigation

• Support escrow teams in the identification, resolution, and prevention of title claims.

• Implement proactive risk management strategies and ensure regulatory compliance in partnership with legal and underwriting teams.

Strategic Program Development

• Design and execute regional initiatives to enhance efficiency, profitability, and customer experience for escrow operations.

• Pilot innovative programs using a test-and-learn approach, iterating based on data and feedback.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including sales, customer service, finance, compliance, and technology, to integrate process improvements and enhance customer satisfaction.

• Act as a resource and escalation point for regional leaders and branch teams.

Technology Integration & Innovation

• Champion adoption and integration of technology platforms to streamline escrow operations and improve customer experience.

• Support IT in developing or improving technology platforms used to close transactions.

• Evaluate and implement new technologies, including BOTs, AI tools, workflow dashboards, and reporting systems, to improve efficiency and accuracy.

• Utilize data analytics to uncover trends, track KPIs, and inform strategic initiatives.

Training & Documentation

• Develop comprehensive training programs to ensure staff proficiency in optimized processes.

• Maintain thorough documentation of operational procedures and updates.

• Foster a culture of teamwork, customer service, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

• 5+ years in title and escrow operations with multi-state oversight preferred.

• Proven expertise in operational support, process optimization, and risk mitigation.

• Strong leadership and team development skills in a support capacity.

• Experience in sales strategy and CRM utilization is a plus.

• Proficiency in operational tools, reporting platforms, and project management systems.

• Ability to travel regionally as needed.

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

We're hiring a Senior IT Auditor to own IT General Controls (ITGC) and technology risk across our audit program. You'll assess risk across our core systems and vendors, design and execute testing where formal processes don't yet exist, and be a key point of coordination with external audit and our co-source partner on all IT-related matters.

This is a hands-on, build-from-scratch role for someone who wants real ownership over how technology risk is assessed and controlled as the company scales - and who's excited to apply AI and automation to make testing faster and more effective, not just more of the same

WHAT YOU’LL DO

You'll work closely with the CIO org, Engineering, Security, Finance, external audit, and our co-source partner to build a rigorous, efficient ITGC program from the ground up.

More than that, we believe you will thrive by taking ownership of:

- Contributing the IT risk assessment and translating it into a prioritized testing plan across access, change management, and operations

- Designing new ITGC testing processes, workpaper templates, and documentation frameworks from scratch

- Coordinating with external audit and the co-source partner on timelines, deliverables, and open items for IT controls

- Leading walkthroughs with system owners and IT stakeholders across key applications and infrastructure

- Testing access provisioning/deprovisioning, change management, and system operations controls across in-scope systems

- Assessing SOC 1/SOC 2 reports for key vendors and subservice organizations, and evaluating complementary user entity controls (CUECs)

- Assessing control deficiencies for severity and root cause, and driving remediation plans to completion with system and process owners

- Implementing AI-driven and automated solutions to reduce manual testing effort and improve testing coverage

WHAT YOU BRING

You're a controls-minded IT audit professional who pairs technical fluency with strong judgment. You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, enjoy owning a program end-to-end, and know how to translate technology risk into a practical testing plan.

- 3+ years of experience in IT audit, ITGC testing, or a related IT risk/compliance function

- Big 4 or co-source firm experience in IT audit

- Demonstrated experience building or significantly enhancing an ITGC testing program or methodology from scratch

- Strong understanding of access management, change management, and system operations control concepts

- Experience reviewing SOC 1/SOC 2 reports and assessing vendor/subservice organization risk

- Strong track record managing external audit and/or co-source relationship

title: Principal Engineer - Game Innovation
description:
What are we building?
Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. Backed by a brand known the world over for gaming, entertainment, and hospitality, we operate like a fast-moving startup with a passion for building products millions of people play.
Our Games Studio is building the next generation of in-house casino content, and we are changing how that content gets made. We are building an AI-assisted development pipeline to design, build, and ship real-money games faster, and using it to go after formats the floor is not saturated with: Crash, Plinko, Mines, arcade-style games, skill-adjacent experiences, and formats that have not been invented yet. Two things at once: a new method for making all our games, and new kinds of games to make with it.
What's the position?
We are looking for a Principal Engineer, Game Innovation to be the technical lead for this effort. You will design and stand up the AI-assisted game development pipeline, own the architecture that takes a game from concept to a certified title live on our RGS, and build games on it yourself. You will pair with the Senior Producer, Game Innovation, who owns the product and the roadmap, while you own the technology and the build.
This is a hands-on principal role, not a management track. You will write code, make the architectural calls, and set the engineering standard for how AI-built games get produced and shipped in a regulated environment. The first question, can AI build a game, is already answered by working prototypes. The harder question is whether we can build a real framework that produces games we would put in front of real players for real money. That is your problem to solve.
Key Responsibilities

• Own the pipeline. Design and build the AI-assisted game development pipeline: a shared project with version control and CI/CD, agents that produce math, art, sound, and animation from a structured brief, automated evaluation gates, and a playable build the team can open from a link. Make it repeatable, so the second game is faster than the first.

• Own the architecture, front end to back end. Set the architecture for the game client and the back-end game server, including the round lifecycle, bet validation, outcome mapping against a certified RNG, wallet operations, reconciliation, RTP reporting, and the audit trail. Keep the math and the money server side.

• Integrate with our RGS. Lead the integration to Fingenuity, our RGS and RNG, and own the path that turns a candidate build into a certifiable, shippable title across jurisdictions.

• Build games, not just infrastructure. Stay hands-on. Prototype mechanics, build game clients and servers, and prove the pipeline by shipping real titles through it.

• Set the AI engineering standard. Define how we use AI-assisted tools and agents in game development: the conventions, the guardrails, the human review gates, and the automated checks that verify AI output before it advances. Nothing AI-generated ships uninspected.

• Choose the stack. Make the build, buy, and partner calls on engine, tooling, and infrastructure, and standardize the studio on choices that are strong for AI-assisted development and support the client and server model.

• Partner across the business. Work with platform engineering, compliance, and our RGS and third-party partners. Bring the studio's math, art, and production talent along, and keep the bar high on quality and speed.

• Raise the bar around you. Mentor engineers who join this effort, establish the code review culture, and document the patterns so the pipeline outlives any one person.

Requirements

We are looking for a builder at principal level who wants to invent the way games get made, not maintain someone else's system. Someone who has shipped real-money games, understands what certification actually demands, and is genuinely excited about what AI does to the economics

title: Customer Service to UX Research Career Changer

About the Program:
Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.
Apprenticeship Requirements:
This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work
Apprenticeship Program Learnings:
Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.
How to Apply:
The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Fractional Technical Product Manager

BRIGHTSCOUT is a global B2B branding and development agency specializing in elevating emerging tech businesses through uniquely crafted brands and standout apps. Comprised of top-tier talent worldwide, we offer a powerful blend of exquisite design, robust development, and strategic acumen. More than a company, BRIGHTSCOUT is a tribe dedicated to disrupting the tech industry with bold ideas and collaborative genius.

The Role

As a Technical Product Manager at BRIGHTSCOUT , you'll decide what gets built and why, then make sure it actually ships. On accounts where the client has their own product team, you'll partner with them to translate their vision into a backlog our engineering and design teams can execute against. On accounts where they don't, you'll be that product team: setting direction, making the calls a client's own PM would make, and representing their business goals inside every planning conversation.

This is a hybrid role by design. Some weeks you're closer to a Product Manager, working the vision, roadmap, and stakeholder tradeoffs. Other weeks you're closer to a Product Owner, writing acceptance criteria and keeping a sprint on track. You'll move fluidly between the two, and know which one a given moment calls for.

Responsibilities

• Product Vision, Client Partnership & Backlog Ownership

• Act as the acting product lead for clients without an in-house PM, building a working command of their business, users, and market deep enough to make credible calls on their behalf.

• Translate ambiguous business goals and stakeholder input into a clear product vision, roadmap, and prioritized, sequenced backlog - grooming it by user value, dependency, risk, and effort.

• Run or support discovery and requirements gathering alongside our Solutions and Delivery teams, turning findings into epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria the team can execute against.

• Represent the client's product interests in internal planning, and represent technical and delivery realities back to the client, in both directions; present roadmaps, tradeoffs, and progress in plain language, holding the line on scope when priorities exceed what a sprint or budget can support.

• Review completed work against acceptance criteria and accept it into the baseline - you're the team's quality gate for whether the work meets the intent, not just the ticket.

Agile Execution, Collaboration & Tooling

• Run or co-run agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retros), keeping the team anchored to sprint and release goals.

• Partner daily with design, engineering, and QA to resolve ambiguity and keep tradeoffs visible to the business side.

• Work alongside our Project Management team on scope, risk, and budget: you own what gets built, they own the plan and the day-to-day client cadence, and the two of you keep each other honest. Coordinate with the shared Capabilities team to keep priorities aligned across concurrent engagements.

• Use AI-assisted tools for research synthesis, spec drafting, and backlog grooming, with the judgment to know when to override a first draft.

• Stay fluent in modern product and delivery tooling (Jira, Linear, Notion, Productboard, or equivalent) and comfortable enough with Figma to work directly with designers.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience spanning product management and product ownership, ideally including agency, consultancy, or client-services work - comfortable owning both ends of the job, from setting direction with a client to writing a precise acceptance criterion.

• Enough technical fluency to hold a real conversation with engineers about architecture tradeoffs, APIs, and technical debt, without needing to write the code yourself.

• Analytically minded and hypothesis-driven, comfortable making calls with incomplete information, with a genuine sense of ownership over outcomes, not just outputs.

• Strong written and verbal communication, able to translate technical constraints

title: M&A-Manager (m/w/d)
description:
deine aufgaben
Für den Ausbau unserer M&A-Aktivitäten suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit mit 4-8 Jahren Erfahrung in M&A oder Corporate Development. Du identifizierst passende Unternehmen, baust nachhaltige Sourcing-Pipelines auf und begleitest Transaktionen vom ersten Kontakt bis zum Closing. Besonders wichtig ist uns Erfahrung im Umgang mit gründergeführten Small Caps.

Deine Aufgaben

• Du baust eine strukturierte Longlist potenzieller Zielunternehmen auf und entwickelst eine verlässliche Sourcing-Kadenz - mit einer Zielgröße von rund 250 Ansprachen pro Jahr.

• Du recherchierst und priorisierst Unternehmen anhand strategischer und finanzieller Kriterien.

• Du verantwortest die Erstansprache und führst einen wertschätzenden, vertrauensvollen Dialog mit Gründerinnen und Gründern.

• Du steuerst Transaktionsprozesse end-to-end - von der Kontaktaufnahme über NDA und LOI bis zum Closing.

• Du koordinierst interne und externe Beteiligte und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte und einen verlässlichen Prozessfortschritt.

• Du erstellst prägnante 2-Pager, Entscheidungsvorlagen und Unterlagen für Beiratssitzungen.

• Du hältst Pipeline, Aktivitäten und Prozessstatus transparent nach und leitest daraus Prioritäten für das weitere Sourcing ab.

dein profil

• 4-8 Jahre Berufserfahrung in M&A, Corporate Development, Transaction Advisory oder einer vergleichbaren Funktion.

• Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Anbahnung und Durchführung von Transaktionen.

• Idealerweise Erfahrung mit gründergeführten Small Caps und ein gutes Gespür für die Perspektive von Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmern.

• Sicherheit in der Recherche und Bewertung potenzieller Zielunternehmen sowie in der strukturierten Pflege einer M&A-Pipeline.

• Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten - besonders in der Erstansprache und im persönlichen Gründerdialog.

• Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen schnell zu erfassen und in prägnanten 2-Pagern und Entscheidungsvorlagen aufzubereiten.

• Eine eigenständige, verbindliche und diskrete Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Organisation und Durchhaltevermögen.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Was dich in der Rolle erwartet
Du verbindest systematisches Sourcing mit persönlicher Beziehungspflege und konsequenter Prozessführung. Dabei erhältst du die Möglichkeit, den M&A-Funnel aktiv mitzugestalten und Transaktionen in einem unternehmerisch geprägten Umfeld voranzubringen.

Wenn du M&A-Prozesse eigenständig vorantreibst, gern mit Gründerinnen und Gründern arbeitest und Erfahrung mit Small Caps mitbringst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Bitte sende deinen Lebenslauf und - sofern verfügbar - eine kurze Übersicht relevanter Transaktionserfahrung.
wir bieten
Neben unserem hoch motivierten Team und einem erfolgreichen Produkt:

✓ Innovation mit Sicherheit: Bei uns trifft Start-up-Atmosphäre auf wirtschaftliche Stabilität.
✓ Work-Life-Balance: Wir fördern einen Arbeitsalltag frei von Überstunden, Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit.

title: RMF / Cybersecurity Compliance Specialist (Pipeline)
description:
About Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC

At Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC , we deliver secure, innovative solutions in support of national defense and intelligence missions. As a trusted government contracting partner, we provide top-tier intelligence and technology services that safeguard our nation. Our team is mission-driven, and we are committed to building careers that matter.

Location: This is a US-based remote position.

Employment Type: Full-Time

Security Clearance: No security clearance required. Minimum active Tier 1 (or higher) federal background investigation required prior to start; ability to obtain a CAC if required by duties.

Join Our Pipeline for Future Opportunities!

This posting is intended to establish a pool of qualified candidates for future openings supporting ongoing operations. Positions may become available based on staffing needs, operational requirements, or workforce changes. Qualified applicants may be contacted as opportunities arise.

Job Summary

Lucayan Technology Solutions LLC is seeking an RMF / Cybersecurity Compliance Specialist to support the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Walla Walla Business Intelligence (WWBI) program. This role owns cybersecurity compliance, Risk Management Framework (RMF) documentation, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and authorization artifacts, working closely with software developers, DevSecOps personnel, technical leadership, and Government stakeholders to ensure WWBI continuously complies with applicable Department of Defense (DoD), U.S. Army, USACE, and Civil Works Business Intelligence (CWBI) cybersecurity requirements. This position also supports maintenance of the WWBI authorization package and the program's planned migration into the CWBI Cloud and eventual integration into the CWBI security boundary.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, update, and maintain WWBI Risk Management Framework authorization documentation, including the System Security Plan (SSP), Continuity of Operations Plan (COOP), Incident Response Plan (IRP), System Design Documents, and related authorization artifacts.

• Manage and document program-specific security controls applicable to the WWBI system, and support security requirements associated with Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

• Maintain documentation defining the WWBI authorization boundary, including applicable hardware, software, ports, protocols, interfaces, and data flows.

• Coordinate cybersecurity documentation and compliance activities associated with WWBI's migration into the CWBI Cloud and eventual incorporation into the CWBI authorization boundary.

• Maintain WWBI compliance records within the Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS), including uploading, mapping, organizing, and maintaining required RMF documentation, security-control evidence, implementation statements, and supporting artifacts.

We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing natural killer (NK) cell-based therapies. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.
We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

• Expert-level proficiency in Python, MATLAB, C/C++, or similar technical computing environments.

• Deep expertise in statistical estimation, signal processing, optimization, and mathematical modeling.

• Strong understanding of machine learning techniques and practical model development.

• Demonstrated experience developing algorithms for sensing technologies, measurement systems, medical devices, or related disciplines.

• Experience analyzing large and complex datasets with multiple signals and dependencies.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
